name: cpp-frontend
body: The C++ frontend artifact (`src/cpplib/main.cpp` plus the vendored tree-sitter runtime and tree-sitter-cpp grammar, `cppfrontend`), built with gcc/g++ and no network. Build-time deps: `gcc` (`-std=c11`) and `g++` (`-std=c++17`); the grammar and runtime are vendored. Scan-time deps: none — a native self-contained binary. Engine pin: vendored tree-sitter (language ABI v15) plus vendored tree-sitter-cpp; the grammar/commit version is currently unrecorded, which this contract must fix.
